description: This file declares an interface for a media browser module, specifically for initializing RPC communication, discovering media servers, browsing content on servers, and cleaning up resources. It provides function prototypes and related macros for interaction with DLNA media servers.

methods.name: InitializeRPC
methods.description: Initializes RPC communication between rdkservice and xupnp dlna counterpart.

methods.name: getDiscoveredMediaServers
methods.description: Retrieves the number of discovered media servers.

methods.name: getDiscoveredMediaServerAt
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific discovered media server by index.

methods.name: browseContentOnServer
methods.description: Requests contents from a specified directory on a media server.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the IPC communication channel between rdkservice and xupnp dlna counterpart.
